references.text: The tabernacle of the testimony is mentioned here, which is the same expression used in Num 1:50 regarding mishkan ha'edut.
The Levites are to camp around the tabernacle of the testimony, which expands on the instruction that they should camp around the tabernacle.
The service of the Levites at the tabernacle and their responsibility for all the utensils is described in more detail here.
The sons of Kohath, who were Levites, were to carry the holy objects, which expands on the Levites' task of carrying the tabernacle and its utensils.
The service of the Gershonites in carrying the tabernacle curtains and accessories expands on the Levites' carrying duty.
The task of the sons of Merari to carry the frames and pillars of the tabernacle expands on the Levites' responsibility for carrying the tabernacle.
The service of the Levites at the tabernacle and their connection to the priests confirms their role as servants in the sanctuary.
The tribe of Levi was chosen to carry the ark of the Lord's covenant and serve before his presence, which corresponds with the Levites' task in Num 1:50.
The Levites and their descendants served at the tabernacle, confirming their role established in Num 1:50.
